description: A cracked tablet a Castoff camp used as its books: what they took and what it cost them. Provisional lore.

log.title: WHAT WE TOOK · WHAT IT COST
log.text:
(kept by Moss, camp at the Scarp wrecks)

2 drill bits, Outpost issue — sold to Nell for 9. Cost: Pell's hand.
1 battery cell, half charge — kept. Cost: nothing, the operator was already dead.
6 Field rounds — kept. Cost: 4 rounds.
1 VDI tag, brass, 'R. ACHÁVAL' — nobody buys these. Kept anyway.

The Outpost let us go when the shafts closed. Said there was no work. There's work. It's just that now we decide the price.

Rule of the camp: if one of us shouts, everyone comes.
Rule of the camp: nobody goes below the Threshold. The Burrowborn don't bargain.
log.text_es:
(lo lleva Moss, campamento en los restos del Scarp)

2 brocas, del Outpost — vendidas a Nell por 9. Costo: la mano de Pell.
1 celda de batería, media carga — nos la quedamos. Costo: nada, el operador ya estaba muerto.
6 balas de campaña — nos las quedamos. Costo: 4 balas.
1 chapa de VDI, de bronce, 'R. ACHÁVAL' — nadie compra esto. Igual nos la quedamos.

El Outpost nos soltó cuando cerraron los pozos. Dijeron que no había trabajo. Trabajo hay. Lo que pasa es que ahora el precio lo ponemos nosotros.

Regla del campamento: si uno grita, vienen todos.
Regla del campamento: nadie baja del Threshold. Los Burrowborn no negocian.
